text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) The copy of HSK level certificate (Level-6 is required by Liberal Arts majors and Level-4 is required by Sciences majors). 6.Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.
